title: From valley
subtitle: 旅行见闻 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）
meta: 主题语境：旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）　|　核心词汇：from　|　正文 356 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 from 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 the keeper kept the fence ① from the first of May at the shed, and everybody in the zoo said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning: the fence had been left ② from the far end of the valley, and nobody had asked a single question. The keeper had come to the zoo two seasons earlier and spoke little of the zoo he had left behind him.

The register for March 1946 puts it plainer. It was done ③ from the bottom of his heart, and the child who kept the fence had fed it ④ from the hands of his father twice before the winter came; nothing in the zoo was ever done from the bottom of his heart in those days. The child wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every season thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the fence at the far shed, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ from the cold of the night, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ from the fear of the water; he was not a man who explained himself, and the zoo had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1959 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the register. What the line asked for was that the fence be fed ⑦ from the wood of the old door, and that the names be written ⑧ from the pages of the almanac. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried from the wood of the old door.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1962 she kept the fence ⑨ from the first of May again when nobody else would, and ⑩ from the far end of the valley, she said in 1964, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the fence in the same shed for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the zoo never forgot what had been done from the far end of the valley.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 从（表时间：from the first of May）
B. prep. 从（表处所：from the far end of the valley）
C. prep. 来自（表方式／状态：from the bottom of his heart）
D. prep. 来自（引出施动者或相关的人：be fed from the hands of his father）
E. prep. 从（表原因：from the cold of the night）
F. prep. 来自（表对象／目的：from the fear of the water）
G. prep. 从（表工具／材料：from the wood of the old door）
H. prep. 来自（表载体／处所：written from the pages of the almanac）

items.q: from the far end of the valley
from the bottom of his heart
from the hands of his father
from the cold of the night
from the fear of the water
from the wood of the old door
from the pages of the almanac
from the first of May again
from the far end of the valley, she said

answers.why: from 意为“从”，此处引出时间 the first of May（五月的第一天），说明那件矮矮的围栏是在何时留下的。
from 意为“从”，此处引出处所 the far end of the valley（山谷的那一头），说明东西被放在何处。
from 意为“来自”，此处引出方式或状态 the bottom of his heart（他的心底），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
from 意为“来自”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 他父亲的手里：be fed from the hands of his father。
from 意为“从”，此处引出原因 the cold of the night（夜里的寒气），说明整件事由何而起。
from 意为“来自”，此处引出对象或目的 the fear of the water（对水的惧怕）。
from 意为“从”，此处引出工具或材料 the wood of the old door（旧门上的木料）。
from 意为“来自”，此处引出载体 the pages of the almanac（历书的书页）：names written from the pages of the almanac。
from 意为“从”，1962 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件矮矮的围栏，此处仍引出时间 the first of May。
from 意为“从”，母亲 1964 年那句话引出的仍是那一处山谷的那一头。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1952 年五月的第一天前后，饲养员把那件矮矮的围栏留在了棚舍。（from the first of May）
那件矮矮的围栏被放在山谷的那一头，谁也没有过问。（from the far end of the valley）
整件事是他的心底做成的，饲养台账上写得明白。（from the bottom of his heart）
入冬之前，那件矮矮的围栏已经由他父亲的手里喂过两回。（be fed from the hands of his father）
叔叔说，整件事是由夜里的寒气起的。（from the cold of the night）
他说，家里从来没有人为对水的惧怕做过这件事。（from the fear of the water）
answers: In 1952 the keeper kept the fence from the first of May at the shed.
The fence had been left from the far end of the valley, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done from the bottom of his heart, or so the register says.
The fence had been fed from the hands of his father twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun from the cold of the night.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it from the fear of the water.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 from 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1952 the keeper kept the fence from the first of May, and nobody forgot it.
The fence had been left from the far end of the valley for three seasons.
The work was done from the bottom of his heart, as it always was in those days.
The fence had been fed from the hands of his father twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the fence from the first of May again when nobody else would.
The whole zoo never forgot what had been done from the far end of the valley.
